author: CNN
description: Australian authorities have released a recording of the level-headed emergency call made by hero teen Austin Appelbee after he swam for hours in rough seas to get help for his family.
title: Hear newly released audio of heroic teen's emergency call

author: CNN
description: A scuffle broke out in Turkey's parliament ahead of the swearing in of new justice minister nominee Akın Gürlek after opposition lawmakers protested against his appointment by President Erdoğan.
title: Scuffle breaks out in Turkey's parliament

author: CNN
description: Newly released video from the Justice Department shows Jeffrey Epstein's former house manager, often called his butler, attempting to sell Epstein’s address book, or “little black book,” to an undercover FBI employee in a 2009 sting operation. title: Video shows Epstein's butler selling 'little black book'

author: CNN
description: James Van Der Beek, the actor who played the leading role in ’90s teen drama “Dawson’s Creek,” has died at 48 years old. Van Der Beek announced in November 2024 that he was living with stage 3 colorectal cancer.
title: ‘Dawson’s Creek’ star James Van Der Beek dead at 48

author: CNN
description: A Pentagon plan to deploy a high‑energy, counter‑drone laser over El Paso, Texas, was abruptly halted after officials realized it hadn’t been coordinated with the FAA, raising concerns about risks to civilian air traffic. CNN’s Pete Muntean reports.
title: Military surprise counter-drone laser closed Texas airspace, sources say

author: CNN
description:

author: CNN
description:
Attorney General Pam Bondi testified at a heated House Judiciary Committee hearing amid ongoing controversies related to the Jeffrey Epstein files release, investigation into President Donald Trump’s political foes and the handling of the fatal shootings of two US citizens in Minnesota by immigration enforcement officers. 

Bondi’s first hour of testimony was combative, devolving into personal attacks on Democrats and screaming matches over whose turn it is to speak. Bondi called Rep. Jamie Raskin – a former constitutional law professor and the top Democrat on the House Judiciary Committee – a “washed up loser lawyer,” as the clash between her and committee Democrats escalated over her approach to their questions.

For live updates, visit: https://cnn.it/3MhMWr5

0:00 Rep. Jayapal asks Bondi to apologize to Epstein victims
1:42 Bondi praises President Trump
2:06 "You don't tell me anything, you washed up loser lawyer"
2:20 Massie tells Bondi he caught her "red-handed" over Epstein fil
title: Epstein files: Bondi, Democrats trade insults during combative hearing

description: During a hearing, Rep. Pramila Jayapal (D-WA) asked Attorney General Pam Bondi to apologize to victims of Jeffrey Epstein, who were in the room, after the Justice Department failed to black out identifying information about many of Epstein’s victims.

author: CNN
description: Ukrainian skeleton athlete Vladyslav Heraskevych told CNN’s Amanda Davies he plans to compete in a helmet honoring 24 Ukrainian athletes killed in the war with Russia — despite an International Olympic Committee ban. The IOC said Tuesday he cannot wear the helmet in competition, citing rules that prohibit political statements on the field of play. Officials suggested he could instead wear a black armband, something Heraskevych says doesn't do justice to those athletes who've lost their lives.
title: Olympic officials banned his helmet. He’ll wear it anyway

title: France to contact 29-year-olds about fertility

author: CNN
description:
The Federal Aviation Administration has issued a temporary flight restriction immediately halting all flights to and from El Paso International Airport in Texas and an area of southern New Mexico for 10 days. 

According to the FAA’s website, the pause over El Paso and Santa Teresa, New Mexico, is due to “special security reasons.” 

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#ElPaso #FAA #News
title: Texas city’s airspace closed for 10 days over security concerns

author: CNN
description: China is facing a boba frenzy after AI company Qwen offered a free drink for downloading it's new app. Alibaba said that the promotion led to 10 million orders of free boba in nine hours, causing chaos for food delivery drivers. CNN's Mike Valerio reports.
title: Free boba frenzy in China caused by AI

description: Before departing Azerbaijan, US Vice President JD Vance said that US athletes competing in the Winter Olympics should "expect some pushback" for discussing politics. #CNN #news

title: Jimmy Lai and Hong Kong Press Freedom

description: In the Canadian province of British Columbia, a tragic incident at a high school resulted in the deaths of at least 10 individuals, including the suspect, who died from a self-inflicted injury. title: Mass shooting at school and home in Canada

description: President Donald Trump wants to build an arch, and he wants it to be the biggest in the world. But even as he suggests he’ll sign an executive order for its construction, the project is facing pushback and will likely hit legal hurdles before it can proceed. CNN's Betsy Klein reports.
title: Trump pushes ahead with 250-foot arch despite concerns
